articles.summary: IRVING, Texas, June 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ebang International Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: EBON, the “Company,” “we,” “us” or “our”) today announced that its subsidiary had successfully won a bid for certain industrial land in Xinghe County, Ulaanqab City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China.
articles.title: Ebang International Announces Acquisition of Inner Mongolia Industrial Land for Amorphous and Nanocrystalline New Materials Project
